target_customer: Companies that make, move and serve physical goods (food, logistics, consumer goods)
problem: Procurement teams run on ERPs, email and spreadsheets and cannot easily use AI agents on them.
business_model: Procurement services and agent platform sold to enterprises

founders.name: Emre Isik
founders.background_notes: YC page: researched embedded AI for motor control at UCLA IPAM.

founders.name: Hakan Enes Aksu
founders.background_notes: Built ad-automation software and sports analysis AI models per YC page.

founders.name: Ali Eren Aytekin
founders.background_notes: YC page: Microsoft Imagine Cup EMEA runner-up and a patent holder.

investors: angels from Airbnb, Volvo Cars, Google, Encord, Sequoia Capital

technical_complexity.rationale: Making ERPs, email and spreadsheets agent-operable with secure actions is integration-heavy but uses existing models.

defensibility.rationale: Many funded procurement AI startups; moat depends on embedded supplier spend and integrations.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Coupa reported committing to autonomous procurement agents; no acquisition of SpaceFlow found.

market_need_then: Procurement is a large spend category; company reports $400M annual supplier spend under management and six-figure contracted revenue, self-reported.

identity.voice_and_tone: Ambitious: target of $1B revenue with headcount capped at 100

brand_strength.rationale: Name is shared with a Prague proptech company called Spaceflow and other space-related names, which causes confusion.

outcome_analysis: SpaceFlow is an active Summer 2026 company that reports early revenue and large supplier spend and raised about $1M around its YC acceptance per Webrazzi. Many funded AI procurement rivals launched in the same months, so the outcome is too early to read.
notes: Round stage not stated by Webrazzi (aggregators say pre-seed), so stage is other. Cross-checked by YesPress and BounceWatch repeating $1M. YC page lists three founders; press adds Ali Orcun Sahinoglu, not listed on YC so excluded. Company site fetch returned only a title. Founding date: YC says 2025, Webrazzi says early 2026. Traction figures self-reported.
